contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG ; R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS

Copper alloy Nummus of Constantine 1, 330-335. Reece period 17. Obverse shows laureate or diademed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG. Reverse shows two soldiers and two standards. Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight 1.26g, diameter 16.30mm
